headline: Every league. One home. (pinned intro)
caption:
🌍 Every league. One home.

Welcome to World Baseball News, your daily source for professional baseball around the globe. MLB, of course, but also NPB in Japan, the KBO in Korea, the CPBL in Taiwan, the Caribbean winter leagues, the minor leagues and the top leagues in Europe and Australia.

41 leagues · 24 countries · 5 continents ⚾

What you'll find here:
📰 Daily headlines from every league
📊 Weekly standings of the leagues in action
🏆 Awards, transfers and title races worldwide

➡️ Swipe for every league we cover.
👉 News, standings, schedules and stats for every league: link in bio.

Follow @worldbaseballnews so you never miss a story from the baseball world.
